# 1 Click World

> A daily geography intuition game. See a place, drop one pin, and discover how close your instinct gets.

## Project

This repository is a public product gallery and limited clean-room reference implementation. Its small offline demo uses synthetic scenes and fixed display outcomes. It is not the production source release and does not connect to the live game.

## Experience

- Daily geography rounds and several ways to play
- A visual place reveal after each guess
- Fictional crowd, league, passport, and progress previews
- A responsive bilingual product gallery
